title: People’s Mañanera September 2
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**The Constitution Puts the People Back at the Center  
** With 27 constitutional amendments and 76 legislative reforms, Mexico has
regained its sovereignty, rights, and the social thrust of its Constitution.
Progress is also being made on republican austerity, the fight against
nepotism and reelection, popular participation, and audience rights vis a vis
the media.

**Regaining Sovereignty Means Reclaiming What Belongs to the People  
** The Fourth Transformation (4T) strengthened Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) and
the Federal Electricity Commission (CFE), recovered passenger rail service,
protected native corn and water resources, and placed limits on foreign
interference. President Claudia Sheinbaum added that “we have restored the
social thrust of the Constitution.”

**From Neoliberal Welfare Handouts to Well-Being Enshrined in Law  
** The Well-Being Programs, fundamental equality for women, and a life free
from violence are now enshrined in the Constitution. By 2026, spending on
Well-Being will reach one trillion pesos (US$58.90 billion), the result of
austerity, honesty, and a government that transforms public resources into
rights.

**No Young Person Should Be Left Without an Education  
** Mexico has opened 245,000 new spaces in public higher education and can
still add an additional 35,000. Sheinbaum added that “no young person who
wants to study should be left without the opportunity to do so.”

**Cooperation, Yes; Interference, Never  
** Mexico maintains cooperation with the United States with tangible results.
Homicides have fallen by 51% thanks to coordination by the Security Cabinet.
In response to any attempt to interfere in internal affairs, Sheinbaum was
clear, declaring that “sovereignty is sovereignty.”

**Lie Detector**

  * It is not true that the Olmeca Refinery is operating poorly and at 41% of its capacity
  * It is not true that the energy demand of the Mayan Train affects energy distribution in the Yucatán Peninsula
  * It is not true that the Felipe Ángeles International Airport (AIFA) is empty and has no flights
  * It is not true that the dual citizenship reform strips away political rights and is intended to block the opposition
  * It is not true that a U.S. helicopter entered Mexican territory and killed alleged hitmen in Mexicali
  * It is not true that a group of protesters set fire to the Israeli Embassy in Mexico City
